name: arcgis-pro-guardian
description: Audit saved ArcGIS Pro projects for broken sources, portability risks, spatial-reference drift, and release-readiness issues.

interface.shortDescription: Find ArcGIS Pro project risks before handoff.
interface.longDescription: Run a local, read-only ArcPy audit over a saved .aprx project and get structured findings for broken layers, missing data, path portability, duplicate names, and spatial-reference drift.
defaultPrompt: Audit this ArcGIS Pro project for release risks.
Find broken layers and missing data in this .aprx.
Check whether this project is portable to another machine.
